requirement:
Awaiting the builder returns the decoded `R` that passes answer vetting under
{cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.agent-calls.vet_answer`. The harness obtains the submitted value under
{cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.agent-harness.submission.acceptance`.
rationale:
The subject has one obligation: awaiting the builder returns the decoded `R` that passes answer vetting. The harness obtains the submitted value under the cited submission acceptance rules. The two cited requirements are context, so I did not reassess their own tests.

- **Decoded value returned (scalar):** `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[default_tool_accepts_scalar_results_and_keeps_the_exact_prefix]` submits `{"result":true}` and asserts that awaiting `ask::<bool>()` returns `true`.
- **Decoded value returned (structured):** `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[typed_submission_references_resolve_and_invalid_results_are_agent_errors]` submits `{"result":{"decision":"Yes"}}` and asserts the returned `Answer` has `Decision::Yes`. `crates/trust-but-verify/src/graph/validation_tests.rs#fn[explicit_insertions_preserve_order_repetition_and_selection_snapshots]` asserts the decoded `Answer` has `n == 7`.
- **Value returned is the one that passed vetting:** `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[vetting_collects_corrections_and_rechecks_every_callback]` first submits `false`, which the callbacks reject. A second submission of `true` is accepted. The test asserts the returned value is `true`, and it asserts `seen == [false, true]`. So the returned value is the resubmitted one that passed every callback, not the first one.
- **Vetting failure is not returned as a value:** `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[vetting_preserves_domain_errors_and_skips_later_callbacks]` asserts that a callback `Err` yields `Err(ValidationError::Graph(..))` and no value. Invalid submissions (wrong type, missing `result`, wrong field name, extra field) yield `ValidationError::Agent` and never reach vetting. The invalid-submission test in `typed_submission_references_resolve_and_invalid_results_are_agent_errors` checks this with `vet_answer(|_| panic!(..))`. `crates/trust-but-verify/src/graph/validation_tests.rs#fn[invalid_typed_submission_is_an_agent_error]` checks it too.
- **No value without a submission:** `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[assistant_text_and_provider_failure_cannot_become_typed_results]` shows assistant text alone, and a provider failure, produce errors instead of a result. `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[unknown_tools_return_errors_without_creating_inputs_or_preventing_submission]` shows an unknown tool call does not block a later `submit_result` from returning `true`.
- **How the harness obtains the value:** the tests also cover the `submit_result` schema, which has a single required `result` property, `additionalProperties` set to false, and `$defs` references that resolve. They cover acceptance of the exact `{result: ...}` object and rejection of malformed objects.

I found no obligation of this subject without a test that asserts its outcome.

text: :::{req} judge.submission
Awaiting the builder returns the decoded `R` that passes answer vetting under
{cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.agent-calls.vet_answer`. The harness obtains the submitted value under
{cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.agent-harness.submission.acceptance`.
:::{req} vet_answer
Each call to `Ask::vet_answer` appends an independent `FnMut` callback to this
request in either builder phase.
For each decoded submission, the harness invokes the callbacks in registration
order with the same `&R`, stopping at the first `Err`. Each callback retains
its state across submissions in the same conversation.
If any callback returns `Err(error)`, the harness MUST stop running callbacks
and end the conversation immediately, even if an earlier callback requested a
correction. Awaiting the `Ask` MUST return
`Err(ValidationError::Graph(error))` carrying the original `D::Error`.
:::{req} submission.acceptance
The harness checks the submission count in a complete model response before
checking submission arguments. An otherwise valid submission while any search
page is open returns a tool error listing every outstanding `search_id` and
instructing the agent to call `finish_search` before resubmitting. The request
stays open and retains its submission reminder. Once all delivered searches
are accounted for under {cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.search.finish_search.behavior`,
exactly one `submit_result` call whose arguments are an object containing only
the `result` field supplies that field's value for decoding and vetting under
{cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.agent-calls.vet_answer`. Acceptance ends the
conversation. Other tool calls in a response containing a submission are skipped.
Assistant prose remains conversation text.
